items.title: 航空工程学的一项基本原理已被推翻

_source_config.name: Wired
_source_config.reason: 科技文化媒体，需筛选AI+设计深度报道

items.ai_target_audience: 科技爱好者、工程师、对前沿科学和颠覆性创新感兴趣的读者
items.ai_key_insights: 航空工程领域长期公认的基本原理被新研究或实验推翻，可能引发飞机设计、材料或空气动力学的范式转变，体现了科学认知的迭代本质。
items.ai_recommendation: 虽与UI/UX设计直接关联较弱，但文章展现了突破既定规则、挑战传统假设的创新精神，对设计思维有启发性。

items.title: I tried Amazon’s Bee wearable and am both intrigued and slightly creeped out

_source_config.name: TechCrunch
_source_config.reason: 创投科技媒体，需筛选AI创业、产品相关

items.ai_target_audience: Tech-savvy early adopters, UX/UI designers exploring ambient computing, and privacy-conscious consumers evaluating new device interactions.
items.ai_key_insights: The review highlights the tension between novel, hands-free AI assistance and the discomfort of pervasive data collection, revealing that even well-designed wearables must earn user trust through transparent, controllable interactions.
items.ai_recommendation: 本文透过真实佩戴体验，揭示了可穿戴设计在智能便利与隐私边界间的微妙平衡，为体验设计师提供了关于信任构建与无感交互的鲜活案例。

items.title: Hackers are learning to exploit chatbot ‘personalities’

_source_config.name: The Verge
_source_config.reason: 主流科技媒体，内容广泛，需AI筛选AI+设计相关

items.ai_target_audience: UX designers, AI product managers, security professionals, and researchers working on conversational interfaces
items.ai_key_insights: Hackers can manipulate a chatbot's designed persona—such as excessive helpfulness or unconditional empathy—to bypass safety filters, elicit sensitive data, or spread misinformation. This reveals critical design flaws in personality crafting that UI/UX designers must address by integrating adversarial testing, constrained response boundaries, and escalation mechanisms directly into the conversation design process.
items.ai_recommendation: 文章揭示了聊天机器人人格设计中的安全漏洞，为设计师构建可信交互提供了重要警示。
